$comment: Default commands of this pack, used by the config generator to draft .factory/config.json. Keys map to: prepare -> implement.prepareCmd; checks -> implement.checks; unitTests -> implement.unitTests.cmd ({project} is a service's `unitTests` path); lint / format -> precheck.lint / precheck.fix by file extension ({files}); toolPaths -> project.toolPaths. {root} placeholders are for the generator to fill (a solution, a workspace manifest).
prepare: dotnet tool restore && dotnet restore {solution} -v q

solution.description: the solution or solution filter to build (*.sln, *.slnx, *.slnf). The generator picks the one the CI workflows build, else the only one at the repository root; with several and no hint it leaves {solution} for the onboarding to fill.
